details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 1 step 5 (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1050, 1076-1087, 1103, 1172, 2003, 2577) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The condition `VALIDATION_ROUTE_OUTCOME=already-fixed` is never true because the variable is only assigned duplicate/bounced/skipped, so the validation-route-fix:v1 marker line is never appended.
  WHY: The poller never records `validation_harness_hold.fix`, so the fix-vs-pin wait (G4) never fires; the condition should use the local `route_outcome` from `_validation_route_outcome()` (line 1103). Severity disagreement: sonnet rated MAJOR, others BLOCKER; highest used.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 4 step 3 Action bullet (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15655-15725) | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_validation_harness_hold_resume` increments and post-checks `validation_harness_resumes.total` itself, and the plan does not say who owns the integration counter or how the post-condition and resume comment change.
  WHY: Switching only the increment target fails the line 15667 post-condition (no resume dispatched), the caller plus the helper incrementing double-counts against the cap of 2, and the comment wrongly claims a harness fix.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 4 step 3 Ancestry bullet / Phase 1 step 8 (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15441-15483) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_validation_harness_hold_compare` is hardcoded to repos/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/compare (line 15455, plus commits GET at 15466) and cannot compare a consumer-repo integration branch, and the plan does not call for a separate helper.
  WHY: The compare returns `__error__` (line 15471) so `integration_compare_failed` repeats every tick and the hold never resumes and eventually parks. Severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet), MAJOR (gemini, qwen), BLOCKER (minimax); highest used. z-ai noted the plan may specify its own compare and treated this as advisory only.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 4 step 3 Ancestry/Persist bullets (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15627-15633, 15689-15695, 15769-15778) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `integration_checked_head` is persisted only on the resume path, and behind/diverged/identical/compare-failed outcomes write no state or `post_state_comment`.
  WHY: STATE_FILE is rebuilt each tick, so the same head is re-compared every tick, breaking the one-compare-per-new-head API budget. Severity disagreement: NIT (most), MAJOR (minimax); highest used.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 Rollback bullet vs Phase 3 step 4 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The job-level `if` skips the job when HEAL_SOURCE_RESOLVED_CLOSE_ENABLED=false, so the promised `outcome=skip reason=disabled` log line is never emitted.
  WHY: An operator verifying the rollback by that log line finds nothing.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 step 2 (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:4913-4919, 4937-4948) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Excluding source-resolved closed heals from `closed_lineage` also removes them from the `resolve_reissue_roots` input set (lines 4939, 4948), so an open re-issue of such a root is no longer matched.
  WHY: `budget_decision` returns action=open instead of the reissue duplicate, so a second heal is filed (Q147 failure mode), and no test covers the case. Minimax rated confidence 3.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:README.md:3876-3886 (Phase 1 step 10 / Phase 3 step 7 / Phase 4 step 6 Docs) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The plan's docs steps do not revise the existing README "Resume" and "Not planned" harness-hold bullets that the new behaviour makes inaccurate.
  WHY: Operators reading the README would expect the old park/resume behaviour (documentation drift).
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 step 3 Queue changes (workflow_failure_heal.py:5883-5893, 5953; workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:36, 164) | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The queue-side widenings for `source-resolved-scan` (HEAL_QUEUE_JOBS, _HEAL_QUEUE_TICKET_RE, queue script accepted list, same-run stale rule requiring a matching job) are not enumerated as one checklist.
  WHY: A missed ticket-regex widening raises ValueError, a missed queue-script check lets the scan proceed unlocked, and a missed job guard lets each scan delete the other's ticket in the same run.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 step 3 (close path label write) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The plan does not address the half-state where the label exists in the repo (ensure_label_exists) but is never attached to the issue.
  WHY: The poller never sees `ai:heal-source-resolved` and never resumes, and the scan repeats the same failure with no diagnostic.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 step 3 and step 4 (source-resolved-scan, Phase 1 step 5 compounding) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Because the queue fails open, an occurrence posted between listing and close can be missed, and the Phase 1 step 5 defect leaves no durable fix record the scan can read.
  WHY: The same fingerprint can be filed twice for the same root cause across two close cycles.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 step 3 (close PATCH retry path) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The plan has no escalation path, per-fingerprint retry cap or distinct log when the label POST succeeds but the PATCH keeps failing on retry.
  WHY: The issue stays open in `ai:workflow-heal` state forever.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Phase 3 step 2: closed heals labelled `ai:heal-source-resolved` are excluded from budget lineage, and "if that listing lacks labels, add `labels` to its existing fields"
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh `_heal_fetch_issue_list` (jq at line 605, lines 601-607); also add tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_queue.py to the plan's file lists
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The jq projection at line 605 omits labels, the Phase 3 Files bullet and Files & Modules (lines 425-427) name the intake script for phases 1 and 2 only, and tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_queue.py is named nowhere, so the scope gate and files_touched commit guard would block the edit and the lineage exclusion would silently do nothing.
- requirement: G4: a consumer harness hold with a recorded fix commit resumes only once the consumer's pin contains that commit (validation-route-fix:v1 marker written and parsed)
  expected_change_site: `_validation_route_post` (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh line 1092) for the marker write; routing-marker reader in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh around line 15320
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The condition `VALIDATION_ROUTE_OUTCOME=already-fixed` is never true (variable only set to ""/skipped/duplicate/bounced at lines 1050, 1172, 2003, 2577), so the marker is never appended, the poller never sets `validation_harness_hold.fix`, and the Phase 4 step 8 compare and the API-cost claim presume a marker that does not exist.
- requirement: Phase 4 step 3: during a harness hold a consumer poller re-validates once per new integration-branch head ahead of the failed run's dispatch head (needs a working consumer-repo compare)
  expected_change_site: new helper (e.g. `_validation_harness_integration_compare`) in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh targeting ${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}, or `_validation_harness_hold_compare` generalised with a repo argument
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `_validation_harness_hold_compare` hardcodes repos/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/compare (line 15455) and commits GET (line 15466), so it returns `__error__` (line 15471) for a consumer integration branch.
- requirement: Phase 3 step 3: `source-resolved-scan` queue job value and ensuring `ai:heal-source-resolved` is added before PATCH
  expected_change_site: HEAL_QUEUE_JOBS, _HEAL_QUEUE_TICKET_RE, workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh accepted list (line 164), heal_queue_position stale rule (line 5953)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: HEAL_QUEUE_JOBS is ("intake","recovery-scan") (line 5883), the ticket regex accepts only those (5885), the queue script enforces only those (164), and the stale rule lacks a `ticket["job"] == mine["job"]` guard (5953); the plan lists these implicitly but does not enumerate them.
- requirement: Phase 3 budget_decision: a source-resolved closed heal adds no generation toward `lineage_cap`, while `resolve_reissue_roots` still finds the closed lineage root
  expected_change_site: `budget_decision` closed-issue branch in scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py (lines 4913-4919) and `resolve_reissue_roots` consumer (4939/4948)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The plan excludes source-resolved closes from `closed_lineage` without addressing its use as the `resolve_reissue_roots` input, and has no test for re-issue of a source-resolved close.
- requirement: Phase 3 step 4: tests for the workflow wiring must verify the `source-resolved-scan` job runs only on `schedule`, not `workflow_dispatch`
  expected_change_site: tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_intake_wiring.py (or the file wiring the job's `if:` predicate)
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The plan says only "extend the workflow wiring test" without naming the file or contract.
- requirement: Update operator-facing documentation for the changed harness-hold resume and close behavior (Phase 1 step 6, Phase 3 step 7, Phase 4 step 6)
  expected_change_site: README.md harness-hold "Resume" and "Not planned" bullets (about lines 3876-3886)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The plan adds only new switch rows and a `Reasons:` bullet; the existing bullets still say a heal must close as completed to resume and that any `not_planned` close parks the project.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 1 step 5 | severity=major | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `VALIDATION_ROUTE_OUTCOME` is only assigned duplicate/bounced/skipped; `already-fixed` comes only from `_validation_route_outcome()`, so the plan's condition is never true.
  WHY: The validation-route-fix:v1 line is never written, `validation_harness_hold.fix` is never recorded, and the step 8 fix-vs-pin wait and G4 do nothing; use the local `route_outcome` at line 1103.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 4 step 3 Action bul
